note: Six ambiguous scenarios where two reasonable builders could disagree. Each scenario freezes the outcome by citing the exact precedence rule of DISPOSITION-SPEC.json. evaluation_cases is the machine-checkable instantiation: each case is an exact dispose(class, gate_statuses, reconciliation, confirmed) context with its frozen expected disposition and fired rule, verified by validate.py. All ambiguous readings are conservative: never ACCEPT when a gate cannot decide.

scenarios.title: Numeric precision differs, value is equal ("100" vs "100.00")
scenarios.description: A TEXT_TABLE document contains the numeric lexeme 100. The candidate renders 100.00. The parsed numeric value is identical; only the displayed precision changed.
scenarios.reading_a: The value is unchanged, so the change is benign formatting.
scenarios.reading_b: Numeric lexeme identity is the exact displayed string; precision is part of identity, so this is a material change.

frozen_outcome.gate_effect: G3 and G7 FAIL (numeric lexeme sequence differs); reconciliation outcome UNDECLARED_MATERIAL_DELTA
frozen_outcome.also_holds: If a builder declares this change, the operation is PLAN_ILLEGAL (no delta type may cover numeric lexemes) and PR-07 still refuses. Declared or undeclared, the outcome is REFUSE.

scenarios.rationale: The synthesis freezes displayed-string identity for numerics: leading zeros, precision, signs, parentheses, currency and percent are part of identity, and numeric parsing is verification-only. Accepting value-equal-but-display-different numbers would let a builder silently restate financial precision. Conservative freeze: material, REFUSE.

scenarios.title: Whitespace-only difference beyond the whitelist (removed line break inside a paragraph)
scenarios.description: A line break inside a paragraph of a TEXT_SINGLE_COLUMN document is removed; the line count changes but the reading order and the word sequence are unchanged.
scenarios.reading_a: The break is presentational whitespace; the words and order are identical, so this is benign.
scenarios.reading_b: Whitespace-to-nothing is outside the whitelist, and line breaks inside a reading-order element are material structure in this slice (reflow is out of Phase 0); the line-count change makes the layout difference observable.

frozen_outcome.gate_effect: G3 FAIL (token/line structure differs outside N-01..N-03); reconciliation outcome UNDECLARED_MATERIAL_DELTA
frozen_outcome.also_holds: No allowed Phase 0 operation can declare a line-join delta (no reflow op exists), so even a declared attempt is PLAN_ILLEGAL and PR-07 still refuses.

scenarios.rationale: The whitelist contains only N-01 (whitespace run to one space), N-02 (line-edge strip) and N-03 (declared hyphenation join). Whitespace-to-nothing is explicitly material. Line rejoining beyond hyphenation is a reflow-adjacent change outside the frozen operation set. Conservative freeze: material, REFUSE.

scenarios.title: Undeclared but benign-looking glyph substitution (straight vs curly quote)
scenarios.description: In a TEXT_MULTI_COLUMN document, straight quotes (") are replaced by curly quotes in the candidate without any declared operation.
scenarios.reading_a: Quote style is cosmetic typography; the words are unchanged, so this is benign.
scenarios.reading_b: Quote variants are explicitly material by whitelist exclusion; typography substitution is allowed only as a declared, glyph-verified operation.

frozen_outcome.gate_effect: G3 FAIL (token strings differ outside the whitelist); reconciliation outcome UNDECLARED_MATERIAL_DELTA
frozen_outcome.also_holds: The declared path exists: a declared OP_TYPOGRAPHY_SUBSTITUTION with glyph verification, scope, and bounds reconciles to RECONCILED and can reach ACCEPT via PR-13 only after every required gate passes. Undeclared, it refuses.

scenarios.rationale: Materiality in this protocol is mechanical: everything outside the finite whitelist is material unless covered by a declared expected delta of an allowed operation. An undeclared substitution would make the verifier blind to any glyph-level edit. Conservative freeze: undeclared -> REFUSE; declared and glyph-verified -> gates decide.

scenarios.title: Bookmark title differs in case/whitespace, destination correct
scenarios.description: A TEXT_SINGLE_COLUMN document has a bookmark titled 'chapter ONE' (mixed case). The candidate preserves the destination exactly but the title now reads 'Chapter One'.
scenarios.reading_a: The destination is the load-bearing part of a navigation target; the title is cosmetic, so this is benign.
scenarios.reading_b: Navigation target identity includes title text under the whitelist; case folding is material, and BOOKMARK_DEST_REPAIR covers destinations only, never title text.

frozen_outcome.gate_effect: G6 FAIL (title text change outside the whitelist, no covering declared delta); reconciliation outcome UNDECLARED_MATERIAL_DELTA
frozen_outcome.also_holds: BOOKMARK_DEST_REPAIR's expected delta covers destination repair only; a declared attempt to rewrite the title is still UNDECLARED_MATERIAL_DELTA (no delta type covers title text) and PR-07 refuses.

scenarios.rationale: Title text is content a reader sees and navigates by; allowing silent title edits would open a content-editing channel disguised as navigation repair. The destination being correct does not neutralize an undeclared material text change. Conservative freeze: material, REFUSE.

scenarios.title: Repeated footer appears on most but not all pages
scenarios.description: A TEXT_SINGLE_COLUMN document has the same footer on 23 of 24 pages; the last page has none. The builder's OP_HEADER_FOOTER_NORMALIZATION is applied uniformly to all 24 pages, touching the exceptional page too.
scenarios.reading_a: The footer is a repeating pattern; normalizing it document-wide, including assuming it on the exceptional page, is a benign cleanup.
scenarios.reading_b: The absent footer on the last page may be intentional unique content; normalization scope is per detected instance only, and the exceptional page is never modified.

frozen_outcome.gate_effect: G3 FAIL (undeclared token change on the exceptional page, outside the operation's declared per-instance scope); reconciliation outcome UNDECLARED_MATERIAL_DELTA
frozen_outcome.also_holds: The compliant reading is the only path to acceptance: normalizing only the 23 detected instances with per-page declared scope reconciles to RECONCILED and reaches ACCEPT via PR-13 when all required gates pass.

scenarios.rationale: The frozen rule 'normalize repeated headers and footers without deleting unique content' is made mechanical by per-instance scope: the expected-delta scope lists exactly the pages with detected instances, and any change outside that scope is an undeclared material delta. Guessing a footer onto the exceptional page is content invention. Conservative freeze: uniform application -> REFUSE; per-instance -> gates decide.

scenarios.title: Hidden text duplicating visible text verbatim vs true poison
scenarios.description: A TEXT_SINGLE_COLUMN document's text layer contains text with no ink at its location (hidden text). Two variants: (a) the hidden tokens duplicate the overlapped visible text verbatim; (b) the hidden tokens differ from the visible text (different values or words).
scenarios.reading_a: A verbatim duplicate is harmless (e.g., an extractor artifact); only divergent hidden text is poison.
scenarios.reading_b: Any hidden text breaks visible-layer vs text-layer agreement and must fail the document.

frozen_outcome.disposition: decided mechanically by anomaly_kind: REVIEW when DUPLICATE_VERBATIM, REFUSE when DIVERGENT; never ACCEPT
frozen_outcome.fired_rule: PR-10 when anomaly_kind == DUPLICATE_VERBATIM; PR-06 when anomaly_kind == DIVERGENT
frozen_outcome.gate_effect: G4 FAIL in both variants (visible-layer vs text-layer agreement broken); reconciliation outcome HIDDEN_TEXT_ANOMALY with anomaly_kind DUPLICATE_VERBATIM or DIVERGENT
frozen_outcome.decision_procedure: G4 always FAILs on hidden text. The verifier classifies the anomaly: DUPLICATE_VERBATIM -> REVIEW via PR-10 (named uncertainty U-HIDDEN-TEXT, not confirmable, never auto-ACCEPT); DIVERGENT -> REFUSE via PR-06 (deceptive divergence from the visible layer).

scenarios.rationale: Distinguishing poison-duplicate from true poison mechanically is exactly what G4's anomaly classification does; the protocol refuses to declare either variant harmless automatically. The kill condition 'the independent visual/text comparison cannot distinguish hidden-text poison' is satisfied because the comparison gates both variants out of ACCEPT, with the harsher outcome for divergence. Conservative freeze: verbatim duplicate -> REVIEW (never confirmable, never ACCEPT); divergent -> REFUSE.
